name: Nautika
bio: Archetype: Bloodtithe, HP Burn, Extra Action. ⌽ Gains [Higge] after every action, which increases max HP. ⌽ Gains [Bloodtithe] when losing HP. Instead of moxie, uses [Faith] to cast Ultimate. Gains [Faith] when [Bloodtithe] increases. ⌽ Skills consume ally HP to deal damage based on her max HP. ⌽ Gains [Mother Spirit's Guidance] when using S2. In this state, launches a follow-up attack when [Bloodtithe] increases. ⌽ Ultimate consumes all [Bloodtithe] to deal damage to random enemies based on the amount consumed.
